About MK Leisure

Built for your life.
Made for the water.

We combine marine engineering, modern residential architecture and bespoke craftsmanship in one iconic houseboat design — tailored inside and out around you.

What we’re all about

One signature boat.
Built around you.

At MK Leisure, we are all about turning life on the water into an effortless, elevated residential experience. Rather than mass-producing generic vessels, we perfected one signature dual-deck houseboat design that can be custom-configured inside to match your lifestyle, family and adventures.

Whether you want 2, 3 or 4 bedrooms, multiple en-suite bathrooms, a full chef’s island kitchen or an expansive upper sky-lounge with a built-in braai, your ideas shape every detail of the floorplan.

We combine precision naval architecture, modern residential finishes and off-grid marine engineering under one roof — creating a floating home that feels unmistakably yours.

Explore our boat, interior spaces & specifications →

01 / Our Mission

Floating spaces
without compromise.

Our mission is to design, engineer and hand-build custom houseboats that unite apartment-grade residential comfort with heavy-duty marine reliability. Every vessel we build starts with our proven dual-deck hull and is tailored from the pontoons up around its owner’s exact room layout and off-grid independence.

02 / Our Vision

Redefining life
on the water.

Our vision is to set the standard for modern floating architecture — transforming dams, lakes and waterways into places where families, friends and hospitality brands can live, host and unwind in timeless luxury, surrounded by nature.
